WITH 
cte_0 AS (  SELECT "orders".customer_id "orders__customer_id", timezone('UTC', date_trunc('month', "orders".ordered_at)::timestamptz) "orders__ordered_month", "orders".store_id "orders__store_id", COUNT(DISTINCT "orders".order_id) "orders__orders" 
  FROM  comparison_orders  AS "orders"
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
  ORDER BY  4  DESC),
cte_1 AS (  SELECT "stores".store_name "stores__store_name", "orders".customer_id "orders__customer_id", timezone('UTC', date_trunc('month', "orders".ordered_at)::timestamptz) "orders__ordered_month", "orders".store_id "orders__store_id", DATE_TRUNC('month', timezone('UTC', "orders".ordered_at::timestamptz)) "orders__ordered_at_month", COUNT(DISTINCT "orders".order_id) "orders__orders" 
  FROM  comparison_orders  AS "orders"
  LEFT JOIN  comparison_stores  AS "stores" ON "orders".store_id = "stores".store_id
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
  ORDER BY  5  ASC),
cte_2 AS (  SELECT "fk_aggregate_keys"."stores__store_name" "stores__store_name", "fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__customer_id" "orders__customer_id", "fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__ordered_month" "orders__ordered_month", "fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__store_id" "orders__store_id", "fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__ordered_at_month" "orders__ordered_at_month", sum("q_0"."orders__orders") "orders__customer_store_month_orders" 
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "stores__store_name" "stores__store_name", "orders__customer_id" "orders__customer_id", "orders__ordered_month" "orders__ordered_month", "orders__store_id" "orders__store_id", "orders__ordered_at_month" "orders__ordered_at_month" 
  FROM  cte_1  AS "cte_1") AS "fk_aggregate_keys"
  LEFT JOIN  cte_0  AS "q_0" ON (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__customer_id" = "q_0"."orders__customer_id" OR (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__customer_id" IS NULL) AND ("q_0"."orders__customer_id" IS NULL)))) AND (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__ordered_month" = "q_0"."orders__ordered_month" OR (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__ordered_month" IS NULL) AND ("q_0"."orders__ordered_month" IS NULL)))) AND (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__store_id" = "q_0"."orders__store_id" OR (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__store_id" IS NULL) AND ("q_0"."orders__store_id" IS NULL))))
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
  ORDER BY  5  ASC),
cte_3 AS (  SELECT "stores".store_name "stores__store_name", "orders".customer_id "orders__customer_id", timezone('UTC', date_trunc('month', "orders".ordered_at)::timestamptz) "orders__ordered_month", "orders".store_id "orders__store_id", DATE_TRUNC('month', timezone('UTC', "orders".ordered_at::timestamptz)) "orders__ordered_at_month", sum(order_total_cents / 100.0) "orders__revenue_usd" 
  FROM  comparison_orders  AS "orders"
  LEFT JOIN  comparison_stores  AS "stores" ON "orders".store_id = "stores".store_id
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
  ORDER BY  5  ASC),
cte_4 AS (  SELECT "fk_aggregate_keys"."stores__store_name" "stores__store_name", "fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__ordered_at_month" "orders__ordered_at_month", sum(CASE WHEN "q_0"."orders__customer_store_month_orders" > 10 THEN "q_1"."orders__revenue_usd" END) "orders__revenue_from_customers_with_10plus_orders_in_store_month" 
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "stores__store_name" "stores__store_name", "orders__customer_id" "orders__customer_id", "orders__ordered_month" "orders__ordered_month", "orders__store_id" "orders__store_id", "orders__ordered_at_month" "orders__ordered_at_month" 
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "stores__store_name" "stores__store_name", "orders__customer_id" "orders__customer_id", "orders__ordered_month" "orders__ordered_month", "orders__store_id" "orders__store_id", "orders__ordered_at_month" "orders__ordered_at_month" 
  FROM  cte_2  AS "cte_2"
   UNION ALL 
  SELECT DISTINCT "stores__store_name" "stores__store_name", "orders__customer_id" "orders__customer_id", "orders__ordered_month" "orders__ordered_month", "orders__store_id" "orders__store_id", "orders__ordered_at_month" "orders__ordered_at_month" 
  FROM  cte_3  AS "cte_3") AS "fk_aggregate_keys_source") AS "fk_aggregate_keys"
  LEFT JOIN  cte_2  AS "q_0" ON (("fk_aggregate_keys"."stores__store_name" = "q_0"."stores__store_name" OR (("fk_aggregate_keys"."stores__store_name" IS NULL) AND ("q_0"."stores__store_name" IS NULL)))) AND (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__customer_id" = "q_0"."orders__customer_id" OR (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__customer_id" IS NULL) AND ("q_0"."orders__customer_id" IS NULL)))) AND (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__ordered_month" = "q_0"."orders__ordered_month" OR (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__ordered_month" IS NULL) AND ("q_0"."orders__ordered_month" IS NULL)))) AND (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__store_id" = "q_0"."orders__store_id" OR (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__store_id" IS NULL) AND ("q_0"."orders__store_id" IS NULL)))) AND (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__ordered_at_month" = "q_0"."orders__ordered_at_month" OR (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__ordered_at_month" IS NULL) AND ("q_0"."orders__ordered_at_month" IS NULL))))
  LEFT JOIN  cte_3  AS "q_1" ON (("fk_aggregate_keys"."stores__store_name" = "q_1"."stores__store_name" OR (("fk_aggregate_keys"."stores__store_name" IS NULL) AND ("q_1"."stores__store_name" IS NULL)))) AND (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__customer_id" = "q_1"."orders__customer_id" OR (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__customer_id" IS NULL) AND ("q_1"."orders__customer_id" IS NULL)))) AND (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__ordered_month" = "q_1"."orders__ordered_month" OR (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__ordered_month" IS NULL) AND ("q_1"."orders__ordered_month" IS NULL)))) AND (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__store_id" = "q_1"."orders__store_id" OR (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__store_id" IS NULL) AND ("q_1"."orders__store_id" IS NULL)))) AND (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__ordered_at_month" = "q_1"."orders__ordered_at_month" OR (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__ordered_at_month" IS NULL) AND ("q_1"."orders__ordered_at_month" IS NULL))))
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  ORDER BY  2  ASC)
SELECT "fk_aggregate"."stores__store_name" "stores__store_name", "fk_aggregate"."orders__ordered_at_month" "orders__ordered_at_month", "fk_aggregate"."orders__revenue_from_customers_with_10plus_orders_in_store_month" "orders__revenue_from_customers_with_10plus_orders_in_store_month" 
FROM  cte_4  AS "fk_aggregate"
ORDER BY  2  ASC,  1  ASC
LIMIT 10000
